svg.text: Schwab - target state (Power BI on Microsoft Fabric)
One governed estate: sources land once in OneLake; every workload reads the same shared, Direct Lake model
INGEST - LAND ONCE (DATA FACTORY / DATAFLOW GEN2)
Direct Lake - one model, no import, governed measures
1 Sources 2 Data gateways (VNet + on-prem) 3 Ingest to OneLake 4 Medallion star 5 Shared model (Direct Lake) 6 Serve: BI, Copilot, Data Agent, MCP 7 Govern + CI/CD

Sources cross a managed gateway (VNet data gateway for cloud, on-premises data gateway for on-prem), land once in OneLake via Data Factory / Dataflow Gen2, are modeled as a medallion star, and feed one shared Direct Lake semantic model. That single model serves Power BI reports, Copilot in Power BI, the Fabric Data Agent, and the GitHub Copilot + Power BI MCP developer loop. Governed by Purview + Entra + CI/CD.
